data_points.source_name: Samjong KPMG via The Korea Herald
data_points.notes: KR dermocosmetics market KRW 4.5tn in 2020, up 17.6% vs five years prior (Samjong KPMG). Article's own USD conversion ~US$3.1bn. Value basis not stated by source; assumed consumer sell-through. cf Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute KRW 1.2tn for same year 2020 (narrower definition) and KERI KRW 4.5tn for 2022 — Korean sources conflict on definition. Article dated 2022-06-23.

data_points.source_name: Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute via Maeil Ilbo
data_points.notes: KR derma cosmetics market grew from KRW 500bn (2017) to KRW 1.2tn (2020) per Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute. Conflicts with Samjong KPMG KRW 4.5tn for 2020 (cf) — 3.75x gap is definitional (this appears to be a narrow pharmacy/cosmeceutical definition). Same article: global derma market US$62.52bn 2022 -> US$94.84bn 2028 (Industry Research). Article dated 2024-01-29.

data_points.source_name: Korean Enterprise Reputation Research Institute via Pharm Edaily
data_points.notes: KR dermocosmetics market KRW 4.5tn in 2022, ~8x growth from KRW 500bn in 2017. cf Samjong KPMG which puts KRW 4.5tn already in 2020 — one of the two vintages is misdated or definitions differ; do not average. Value basis unstated. Article dated 2025-08-13.

data_points.source_name: Korean Enterprise Reputation Research Institute via Pharm Edaily
data_points.notes: PROJECTION: KR dermocosmetics market projected KRW 5.5tn for 2025 (from KRW 4.5tn 2022, implying ~7% CAGR 2022-2025). Consistent direction with Euromonitor +13% growth read for 2024 already on file. Article dated 2025-08-13.

data_points.source_name: 한국기업평판연구소 (Korean Enterprise Reputation Research Institute) via Youth Daily (청년일보)
data_points.notes: REFRESH/PRECISION: '국내 더마코스메틱 시장 규모는 지난 2017년 5천억원에서 2022년 약 4조5천325억원으로 10배 가까이 성장했으며' — KRW 4.5325tn in 2022, up from KRW 0.5tn in 2017 (~10x). ~USD 3.066bn @ USD/KRW 1478.40 pinned 2026-07-21. This is the precise figure behind the KRW 4.5tn (2022) already on file from Pharm Edaily; same underlying institute, so treat as the same series, not a second observation. Value basis not stated by source; assumed domestic consumer sell-through (NOT export FOB, NOT MFDS production value). Article dated 2025-04-18.

data_points.source_name: 한국기업평판연구소 (Korean Enterprise Reputation Research Institute) via Youth Daily (청년일보)
data_points.notes: PROJECTION: '올해는 5조5천억원을 넘어설 것으로 전망된다' — expected to EXCEED KRW 5.5tn in 2025 ('올해' = this year; article dated 2025-04-18). ~USD 3.720bn @ USD/KRW 1478.40 pinned 2026-07-21. Stated as a floor, not a point estimate. Independently corroborates the KRW 5.5tn 2025 projection already on file from Pharm Edaily. cf DailyBeautyDrop/cogonggo (2025-05-04) which states the softer '5조 원 돌파' (exceed KRW 5tn) for 2025 — same direction, lower threshold.

data_points.source_name: Derived from 한국기업평판연구소 via Youth Daily
data_points.methodology: CAGR computed from the two endpoint values stated on the fetched page: KRW 0.5tn (2017) to KRW 4.5325tn (2022), 5 years. (4.5325/0.5)^(1/5)-1 = 55.4%. Assumptions: both endpoints are on the same definition and same value basis (the source does not state either); no rebasing of the definition occurred between 2017 and 2022. Sensitivity: if the 2017 base were understated by using a narrower cosmeceutical/pharmacy definition (the Korea Cosmeceutical Education & Research Institute series already on file puts 2020 at only KRW 1.2tn vs KPMG's KRW 4.5tn), true CAGR could be materially lower; range 25-55%. Treat as an order-of-magnitude growth read, not a precise rate.
data_points.notes: Historical, not forward-looking. The KRW 0.5tn (2017) base is the single most likely source of overstatement — Korean sources disagree ~3.75x on the dermocosmetics definition for 2020 alone. Recorded because the direction (explosive category formation off a tiny base) is the load-bearing fact for corridor whitespace #5, not the precise rate.

data_points.source_name: Derived from 한국기업평판연구소 via Youth Daily
data_points.methodology: CAGR computed from KRW 4.5325tn actual (2022) to KRW 5.5tn projected (2025), 3 years: (5.5/4.5325)^(1/3)-1 = 6.66%. Assumptions: the 2025 figure is a same-definition projection by the same institute; it is stated as a floor ('넘어설 것으로 전망'), so 6.66% is itself a floor. Sensitivity: if 2025 lands at the softer cogonggo threshold of KRW 5.0tn the CAGR is 3.3%; if it lands at KRW 6.0tn it is 9.8%. Range 3.3-9.8%.
data_points.notes: CORRIDOR WHITESPACE #5. Note the sharp deceleration versus the 2017-2022 formation phase (~55% CAGR derived) — the Korean dermocosmetics category is transitioning from explosive formation to mid-single-digit maturity. No publisher-stated forward CAGR for KR dermocosmetics could be verified on a fetchable page: Grand View Research's South Korea cosmeceutical horizon page (reportedly USD 556.4mn 2024 to USD 825.3mn 2030 at 6.7% CAGR 2025-2030) returned HTTP 403 and is therefore NOT cited. cf SPER Market Research 5.45% (2024-2033), also recorded here — both cluster mid-single-digit, which is the useful convergence.

WARNING: the CAGR is taken but the source's companion endpoint is not credible — SPER states the market reaches 'USD 27.89 billion by 2033', which exceeds Korea's ENTIRE domestic BPC market (~USD 13bn) by more than 2x and cannot be a cosmeceuticals sub-category. The level figure is treated as suspect and is NOT claimed; only the rate is recorded. SCOPE CAVEAT: 'cosmeceuticals' is a narrower/differently-drawn definition than the Korean-language '더마코스메틱' series. cf Bonafide Research USD 3.86bn by 2030 (recorded separately), which IS scale-consistent with the KRW 5.5tn 2025 Korean figure.

FORECAST VALUE, stated as a floor: 'the South Korea Cosmeceutical market is expected to reach a market size of more than USD 3.86 Billion by 2030'. Report base year 2024, forecast year 2030; no CAGR disclosed on the page. Scale-consistent with the Korean-language series (KRW 5.5tn 2025 = ~USD 3.72bn @ 1478.40 pinned 2026-07-21), which is the main reason it is recorded. Value basis not stated; assumed consumer sell-through. cf SPER USD 27.89bn by 2033 — 7x higher and not credible, do not average.
